label: Isle of Man Oak-Smoked Mature Cheddar

branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: A mature cheddar from the Isle of Man Creamery, cold-smoked over oak chips after it is made.

sources.text: The creamery's product page, which gives the cold smoking over oak chips, and the Isle of Man article on smoked Manx cheese.
